differences.title: 1. DATA FLOW
differences.leftDesc: SolidJS Signals push updates automatically downstream when dependencies change, ensuring only impacted nodes re-run. Reactive sources emit via effect systems without pull overhead.
differences.rightDesc: Vue reactivity pulls values on-demand when effects run, recalculating entire dependency chains reactively via Proxy traps and getter traps.

differences.title: 2. MEMORY FOOTPRINT
differences.leftDesc: Signals maintain tiny memory overhead due to direct dependency tracking; no intermediate proxy caches or hidden objects.
differences.rightDesc: Vue's Proxy-based system adds layer of indirection via getters/setters, with hidden observers for each reactive object.

differences.title: 3. RENDER OPTIMIZATION
differences.leftDesc: SolidJS components compile to static expressions; signals bind directly to DOM nodes via compiler optimizations.
differences.rightDesc: Vue's reactivity dynamically recalculates entire templates; v-once and async boundaries attempt to mitigate but still rely on pull.

differences.title: 4. SYNCHRONIZATION
differences.leftDesc: Signals update synchronously in call stack order, ensuring UI consistency without microtasks or rAF scheduling.
differences.rightDesc: Vue queues effects in a microtask queue, flushing asynchronously to batch updates and avoid UI clobbering.

differences.title: 5. COMPONENT LIFECYCLE
differences.leftDesc: SolidJS components share no lifecycle; effects run outside component tree, avoiding hook chains and memory leaks.
differences.rightDesc: Vue components integrate with hooks (setup, mounted) that depend on reactivity graphs, creating intertwined lifecycle trees.

differences.title: 6. SSR HYDRATION
differences.leftDesc: SolidJS signals serialize to exact DOM states; client hydrates using same signal graph, avoiding diffing algorithms.
differences.rightDesc: Vue SSR hydrates by diffing server-rendered DOM with client reactivity, recalculating mismatches post-hydration.

differences.title: 7. THIRD-PARTY INTEGRATION
differences.leftDesc: SolidJS requires explicit signal wiring to external stores; no automatic reactivity propagation to libraries.
differences.rightDesc: Vue reactivity automatically propagates to libraries using VueUse composables or Proxied objects, reducing boilerplate.
